_comment: Skill templates; keys are skill names (identity, not overridable). Absent fields keep the compiled defaults. This file carries CONSTANTS and engine-checked data only -- never behaviour: trigger = action|passive|intention, target = none|self|any|multi|point, attack_test = none|melee|ranged (which also fixes the cast range), cooldown/intention_duration in seconds, and per-skill constants each skill's own code reads by name.

Calcify.effect: Absorbs the next physical strike, then shatters.

ShieldBash.effect: Slams the target with a shield; a landed blow leaves it stunned.
